title: Pricing Creativity w/ Blair Enns Livestream
description:
Livestream w/ Blair Enns. Got questions for author, speaker, consultant Blair Enns? Get them ready.
#WWPM #PricingCreativity


02:57 - Specialize vs. Generalize
04:30 - "but what if I get bored when I specialize?"
08:00 - How do I begin to specialize? Where do I start?
12:46 - Why don't we talk about money early?
18:20 - How did Blair embrace silence when talking about business?
21:40 - How do you measure the value you bring?
28:30 - Profit is based on the risk you take
31:00 - 2 ways of being successful in business 
34:15 The pursuit of efficiency comes at the cost of extraordinary profit 
37:00 - How much of a cut do I take from the value I bring?
48:16 - Risks you might encounter when leveling up
51:00 - VALUE BASED PRICING
56:00 - Can't I just raise my hourly rate?
1:03:00 - Price the client, not the service
1:11:00 - Don't feel the need to bring out the cost, ask questions
1:15:00 - Recap
